newsitem.title: USA: US high-yield debt rises, investment grades firm.
newsitem.headline: US high-yield debt rises, investment grades firm.

text.p: U.S. high-yield debt prices were lifted in quiet trade on Friday by a regenerated Treasury market and reports of still-strong infusions of cash to mutual funds, dealers said.
Investment grade bond spreads, meanwhile, were firm throughout the session but traders there too stressed activity was thin with few transactions to prove levels.

Topping the high-yield market, dealers said approximately $600 million in mutual fund cash inflows fueled buying and positive sentiment and most prices in general rose by 1/2 point in rapidly thinning trade.
New issues provided fodder for most of the day's action, traders said, with the bulk of them bid more than one point higher when freed to trade.

--Phonetel Technologies Inc's $125 million 12 percent par 10-year senior notes were quoted at 102-1/4; Katz Media Corp's $100 million 10-1/2 percent par 1/15/2007 senior subordinated notes were quoted at 101; and Safelight Glass Corp's $100 million 9-7/8 percent par 10-year senior subordinated notes were quoted at 101-3/8.
Cable wireless bonds were casualties of the day.

CAI Wireless Systems Inc bonds dropped five points after news the company's partnership agreement with Bell Atlantic and NYNEX Corp was suspended for one year. Bell Atlantic said the move clears the way for CAI to better develop its Multichannel Multipoint Distribution Service (MMDS) transport systems.

CAI's $275 million 12-1/4 percent senior notes were quoted at 40 bid, 45 offer near the close compared with a 45 bid late on Thursday and a 35 bid at Friday's open. Like the rest of the market, the bonds were thinly traded, one trader said.

Elsewhere, Stratosphere Corp's 14-1/4 percent first mortage notes were quoted unchanged to marginally lower before the December 15 end of a 30-day grace period for the company to make a $14.5 million interest payment.

Stratosphere has said it did not expect to make the payment after it failed to meet its November 15 obligation. It is currently seeking additional financing for additional construction and a restructuring of its mortgage debt.
The company declined to comment on Friday as to its intentions in meeting interest payments or to ongoing bondholder negotiations.
The notes were bid as low as 91 and as high as 93.

Turning to investment grades, spreads on some Tele-Communications Inc debt tightened by 10 basis points on talk the company may consider selling its 30 percent interest in Sprint Spectrum L.P. Spreads first improved on Thursday after TCI CEO John Malone said the company plans to shift its focus on increasing the profitability of its core assets.

Thursday's mega $1.2 Crown Cork & Seal 100-year bonds tightend by one basis point when they were freed to trade on Friday. But bids on the company's 10-year bonds were wider by one basis point, and bids on its 30-year paper were wider by two basis points, traders said.
New issues on Friday included $100 million 7 percent 10-year notes from Reynolds & Reynolds Co, priced to yield 7.039 percent or 73 basis points over the curve.
Also, MidAmerican Energy Financing, a unit of MidAmerican Energy Holdings, issued $100 million in trust preferred securities.
In the Treasury market, the benchmark 30-year bond closed up 20/32 at 99 to yield 6.58 percent.
